description: Angular component for assigning entities (devices, assets, edges, entity views) to customers via a dialog interface, including form handling and service calls.

classes.name: AssignToCustomerDialogData
classes.description: Interface defining the data passed to the assign-to-customer dialog, including entity IDs and entity type.

classes.name: AssignToCustomerDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for a dialog that assigns multiple entities to a customer, handling form input, validation, and service calls.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and sets dialog titles and texts based on entity type.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state, considering submission status.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without making changes.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Handles the assignment process by creating tasks for each entity and executing them concurrently.

methods.name: getAssignToCustomerTask
methods.description: Returns an observable for assigning a specific entity to a customer, based on entity type.
